name: Kaizen Agro Infrabuild Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2006, Kaizen Agro Infrabuild 
Ltd is in the business trading of agricultural products[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
KAIL used to be a wholesaler/trader of consumer goods. Later, it got involved in construction and civil works and has completed 1231+ Projects with 499+ Clients. Currently, the company is into new line of Agriculture Business by manufacturing and trading of Agro products

pros: Stock is trading at 0.55 times its book value
Company is expected to give good quarter
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 0.32% over last 3 years.
Company has high debtors of 483 days.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -34.5%
Working capital days have increased from 491 days to 792 days
